description: Create a card on a board. Title is required; give the target column by id or by title (omitted = the board's first column). idempotencyKey makes a retry safe: re-sending the same key after a lost response or a 5xx returns the ORIGINAL card instead of a duplicate.

assigneeIds.description: Workspace member ids; must be members of the board's group.

boardId.description: Board id. Provide this or boardRef.

boardRef.description: Board key/title instead of boardId, resolved via the board list.

columnId.description: Target column id. Provide this or columnTitle.

columnTitle.description: Target column title, resolved against the board's columns.

dueDate.description: "YYYY-MM-DD" (anchored at noon UTC) or a full ISO 8601 timestamp. null clears it.

estimateSeconds.description: Time-tracking estimate in seconds. Requires the timeTracking plan feature to set a non-null value.

name: zuuna_create_card
